# OpenComputer dashboards

Live dashboards — no login required. Refreshes every 30 seconds as telemetry arrives.

- **[Live response latency](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/04826d8266c44db095c5029bf7965421)** — Response median and p95, model waits, platform overhead and coverage.

- **[Speed](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/003d2946a46041659cce0e34278afc07)** — Acknowledgement, first output, first content, overhead and silence.

- **[Cold path](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/9820b7d2a0ff4cd4b8ba7c46ad634597)** — Workspace setup, runner launch and startup stages.

- **[Models and harnesses](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/c4f492431622456bae32b134ef784150)** — Model first-token waits, cache hit rates and sample counts.

- **[Reliability](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/8bfcbf94b711457b97b93260a39cf976)** — Turn outcomes, dispatch trouble, frontend errors and telemetry loss.

- **[Machine health](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/55b07db24aa241c4be0c196fbc4150f4)** — CPU, memory, disk and runner load across anonymized machines.

- **[Trace timings](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/834035649f5846b792b765e9d474d1ee)** — Aggregate event durations; individual traces remain private.

- **[Computer API](https://opencomputer.grafana.net/public-dashboards/8ee8e3892d2e49ada9f36fc29847bfc1)** — API latency, response statuses and journal performance.

All views use UTC. Latency p95 needs at least 20 measurements per bucket. Public views exclude customer and individual trace identifiers; machine labels are anonymized.
